globalThis.comparison=(()=>{
 const v=globalThis.variant??0,checks={},near=(a,b)=>Math.abs(a-b)<=1/64+.000001;
 const sheet=document.createElement('style');sheet.textContent='html,body{margin:0;padding:0}div{margin:0;padding:0;border:0}';document.head.append(sheet);
 const base='display:block;width:'+(60+v)+'px;height:30px;font:16px/20px serif;';
 const box=css=>{const node=document.createElement('div'),child=document.createElement('div');node.style.cssText=base+css;child.style.cssText='width:20px;height:10px';node.append(child);document.body.append(node);return node;};
 const equal=(a,b)=>{const x=a.getBoundingClientRect(),y=b.getBoundingClientRect(),ac=a.firstElementChild.getBoundingClientRect(),bc=b.firstElementChild.getBoundingClientRect();return near(x.width,y.width)&&near(x.height,y.height)&&near(ac.x-x.x,bc.x-y.x)&&near(ac.y-x.y,bc.y-y.y)&&a.scrollWidth===b.scrollWidth&&a.scrollHeight===b.scrollHeight;};
 const run=(name,logical,physical)=>{const a=box(logical),b=box(physical);checks[name]=equal(a,b);a.remove();b.remove();};
 run('inlineStart','border-inline-start:4px solid red','border-left:4px solid red');
 run('inlineEnd','border-inline-end:5px dashed blue','border-right:5px dashed blue');
 run('blockStart','border-block-start:6px dotted green','border-top:6px dotted green');
 run('blockEnd','border-block-end:7px double black','border-bottom:7px double black');
 run('inlinePair','border-inline:3px solid red','border-left:3px solid red;border-right:3px solid red');
 run('blockPair','border-block:2px solid blue','border-top:2px solid blue;border-bottom:2px solid blue');
 run('widthStyle','border-inline-start-width:8px;border-inline-start-style:solid','border-left-width:8px;border-left-style:solid');
 run('logicalLast','border-left:9px solid red;border-inline-start-width:2px','border-left:2px solid red');
 run('physicalLast','border-inline-start:9px solid red;border-left-width:2px','border-left:2px solid red');
 run('logicalImportant','border-inline-start:4px solid red!important;border-left:9px solid blue','border-left:4px solid red');
 run('physicalImportant','border-left:5px solid red!important;border-inline-start:9px solid blue','border-left:5px solid red');
 run('none','border-inline:9px none red','border-left:0;border-right:0');
 run('hidden','border-block:9px hidden red','border-top:0;border-bottom:0');
 run('fraction','border-inline-start:.4px solid red;border-block-end:2.9px solid red','border-left:1px solid red;border-bottom:2px solid red');
 run('fontRelative','border-inline-start: .5em solid red','border-left:8px solid red');
 run('math','border-block-start:calc(3px + 2px) solid red','border-top:5px solid red');
 run('variable','--edge:6px;border-inline-end:var(--edge) solid red','border-right:6px solid red');
 run('initial','border-inline:8px solid red;border-inline-start-width:initial','border-left:3px solid red;border-right:8px solid red');
 const a=box('border-inline-start:2px solid red'),b=box('border-left:7px solid red');a.style.borderInlineStartWidth='7px';checks.mutation=equal(a,b);a.remove();b.remove();
 const parent=box('border-left:6px solid red'),child=parent.firstElementChild;child.style.cssText=base+'border-inline-start-width:inherit;border-inline-start-style:inherit';const control=box('border-left:6px solid red');control.firstElementChild.remove();const empty=document.createElement('div');empty.style.cssText='width:20px;height:10px';child.append(empty);const other=document.createElement('div');other.style.cssText='width:20px;height:10px';control.append(other);checks.inherit=equal(child,control);parent.remove();control.remove();
 sheet.remove();return checks;
})();
